models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.hardware: 2x RTX 5060 Ti 16GB (32GB total, all layers split across both cards, MTP draft head)
engines.quant: IQ4_XS weights, q4_0 KV cache with flash attention, 262k context in two 128k slots; IQ4_XS also 20% faster than Q5_K_M at the same score
engines.engine_min_version: -fa (flash attention) with q4_0 KV cache; built-in MTP draft head (--spec-type mtp)

models.why: Siim Tolk's overnight harness ran his production Qwen3.8-27B at 45 tok/s decode on a short prompt on two RTX 5060 Ti cards (IQ4_XS 15.5GB, 262k context in two 128k slots); the built-in MTP draft head alone took it from 25 to 41 tok/s for 1.2GB of extra memory, decode falls to 26.5 tok/s after 90k tokens, and each card needs ~2.8GB of compute buffer.
